partition.selection_rule: Sort the 95 unique project identities whose benchmark-register membership is IN_PROMPT_UNIQUE_95 by lowercase identity, select zero-based slice [32:64], lowercase every selected identity, join with LF and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes.

input_pins.project_universe_definition: lowercase lexical LF join of the 95 IN_PROMPT_UNIQUE_95 project identities, no trailing LF

method.source_boundary: Official GitHub repository metadata, repository-root files at immutable commits, and repository files at immutable commits only.
method.network_method: Authenticated read-only GitHub API content requests and official github.com immutable blob loci; no repository clone, dependency installation, build, application execution, or test execution.
method.licence_rule: A GitHub metadata SPDX value is recorded only with a verified root licence locus. When metadata returned NOASSERTION, root text was inspected; ambiguous qualifiers, path-specific mixed licensing, or an absent root licence remain explicitly blocked.
method.behaviour_rule: Each observation is bounded to the cited immutable source slice. It is an upstream observer fact, not equivalence to an Oblivion canonical target.
method.architecture_boundary: Oblivion Findings is single-tenant and multi-Site. No upstream workspace, household, project, facility, organisation, or realm construct is treated as tenant or Site authorization evidence.
